summary.en: Roman poet of the age of Augustus, born near Mantua. He wrote the Eclogues, the Georgics and the Aeneid, the epic of Rome's founding. The Middle Ages read him as a sage, almost a prophet.

en: Born at Andes, near Mantua, in 70 BC
Wrote the Eclogues, the Georgics and the Aeneid
